API ReferenceZscaler Internet Access APITraffic ForwardingExtranet Resource Get All Extranet
Extranet Resource Get All Extranet
GET
https://api.zsapi.net/zia/api/v1/extranet

Retrieves the list of extranets configured for the organization. Extranets are configured as part of Zscaler Extranet Application Support which allows an organization to connect its internal network with another organization’s network (e.g., partners, third-party vendors, etc.) that does not use the Zscaler service. Extranet Application Support enables Zscaler-managed organization users to securely access extranet resources through an IPSec VPN tunnel established between the Zscaler data center and the external organization’s data center, without requiring additional hardware or software installations.

To learn more, see Understanding Extranet Application Support and About Extranet.

Request
​
QUERY PARAMETERS
pageSize
int32

Specifies the page size. The default size is 200.

Default value: 200
page
int32

Specifies the page offset

Default value: 0
orderBy
string

The field used to sort the list in a specific order

Default value: name
order
string

The arrangement of the list in ascending or descending order

Default value: ASC
search
string

The search string used to match against specific extranets

Responses
​
200

Successful Operation

APPLICATION/JSON
Schema
Example (auto)
SCHEMA
Array [
id
int32

The unique identifier for the extranet

name
string

The name of the extranet

description
string

The description of the extranet

extranetDNSList
object[]
extranetIpPoolList

Information about the traffic selectors specified for the extranet. Type: Array

createdAt
int32

The Unix timestamp when the extranet was created

modifiedAt
int32

The Unix timestamp when the extranet was last modified

]
